name: Hrishi Olickel
bio: Hrishi Olickel is the founder and CEO of Southbridge AI, a San Francisco and Singapore company building data agents and what he calls the stack for Data AGI. Southbridge turns messy, long-tail data such as health records, financial filings, and decades of sensor readings into usable form. Before Southbridge, he spent about five years as co-founder and CTO of Greywing (YC W21), a maritime software company, where his team built SeaGPT, an early maritime AI agent, and helped tens of thousands of stranded seafarers return home during Covid. He co-authored Oyente (ACM CCS 2016), a symbolic-execution tool that flagged more than $62M in exploitable Ethereum smart contracts. Forbes named him to 30 Under 30 Asia 2023 in Enterprise Technology. He did research at Yale-NUS College and writes about LLMs, RAG, and agents on his blog.

sessions.title: Extra lunch talk: no universal schema — just-in-time ontologies, model priors, and Pareto surfing (Southbridge)
